description: Persona acceptance evals: a developer prompt should route to the expected skill. The deterministic test checks each skill description is discriminative enough that the expected skill scores highest on keyword overlap. A gated real-CLI harness (documented in tests/test_persona_evals.py) exercises actual trigger behavior.
